gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Eater brings thin strokes beside weightier stems, with wide gaps between letters and short ascenders that give it a dark, aggressive bite. Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase beneath it.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Dark and aggressive, Eater spaces its letters wide and keeps its ascenders short. Noto Sans Khmer, a sans-serif with generous openings and near-capital small letters, holds up even at a modest size.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Wide exits and a large, clear eye on every e give this body text a modern, clean read. Noto Sans Khojki does the reading, whereas Eater keeps its dark, widely spaced menace for display sizes.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi reads clean and approachable, its capitals barely taller than lowercase. Its rounds stay unsealed, so paragraphs would glide along gently after the dark lettering of Eater.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR leaves generous gaps in its curves and sets stubby ascenders against a big x-height. And Eater supplies the dark, aggressive edge, a sharp jolt of temperament against all that openness.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-lao: Snarling and widely spaced, Eater looks ready to bite. Eater earns its keep big and brief, while Noto Sans Lao, with its tall x-height and open mouths, handles everything quieter.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Aggressive in mood, Eater carries a lightly shaded texture through each word, its letters set wide apart. Noto Sans Lydian is approachable and plain, its capitals barely above lowercase, a lit window beside that dark room.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplem: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement draws round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky. Audiowide looks wire-bent; let the sans stay modest in size.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems give Eater its dark, aggressive bite, best when it is big and brief. Noto Sans Mahajani stands its lowercase tall against the capitals and gives each e a funnel-wide throat.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Ornate in mood, Almendra Display carries a pronounced x-height and letters that never seem to pinch shut. Noto Sans Tangsa, a sans-serif with wide round openings, would carry paragraph after paragraph without fuss.
